acceptanceCriteria: A supported landing watcher classifies CI failures against a declared flake list and reruns within a cap
Bot merge-queue ejection is re-queued within a cap; human dequeue is never overridden
Every unrecoverable state produces an escalation event the owning session receives
body: Observed 2026-10-18: detached per-PR waiters exited on any non-infra CI failure (known flake TestPSRV0111) without notifying the session, and kept polling with auto-merge off after github-merge-queue ejected #1085/#1094. Six PRs sat 06:00-10:40Z until the owner asked. Interim fix in the orchestrator scratch tooling: known-flake rerun (max 3 attempts), bot-ejection re-arm (max 2), and an alerts file tailed by a session-tracked Monitor. Product gap: Corvint/Tasks has no supported PR-landing supervisor that classifies failures (flake vs real), re-queues after bot ejection, and escalates to the owning session.
title: Orchestrator PR waiters exit silently on CI failure and never re-arm after merge-queue ejection
